messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "10 mg subcutaneously once a week for children 10 years and older with Type 2 Diabetes"
set: ["10 mg subcutaneously once a week for children 10 years and older with Type 2 Diabetes", "2.5 mg subcutaneously once a week for Type 2 Diabetes", "15 mg subcutaneously once a week for adults with Type 2 Diabetes", "10 mg subcutaneously once weekly for OSA", "10 mg subcutaneously once weekly for weight loss", "2.5 mg subcutaneously once a week", "15 mg subcutaneously once a week", "children with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: 5 mg to 20 mg once daily for those 10 years of age and older", "10 mg once daily", "10 mg orally once a day", "10 mg/day for adolescents and higher-weight children", "10 mg/day for lower-weight children", "10 mg or 20 mg per day for children and adolescents aged 8 and older", "10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "2.5 to 10 mg orally once a day", "5 to 10 mg orally once a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
